question.text: What is 'Restatementization' of mutual fund units?

answer.text: Converting demat MF units back to Statement of Account (SoA) / physical form
Converting physical SoA to demat form

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, Restatementization is the process of converting MF units held in electronic form back to physical Statement of Account / certificate form, and is initiated via the MF-RRF (restat request) process. The Trap: Converting physical SoA to demat form is the reverse process (De-statementization). Merging schemes and switching schemes are unrelated MF workflows. Note: Cross-references to Series V-A or scheme operations (SIP/STP/direct-AMC) are not stated on the checked pages and should not be presented as workbook-supported reasoning for restatementization.
